reauth_confirm.title: Lutron login rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Lutron processor at {host} refused the integration login. Enter the integration username and password set in the Lutron programming software (RadioRA 2 default: lutron / integration).

abort.reauth_successful: The new login works. Lutron LIP is reconnecting.
